title: Prompts and probabilities in the linguistic assessment of language models: Evidence from semantic focus-sensitivity
abstract: arXiv:2610.39923v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As language models (LMs) have improved, an increasingly common means of evaluating their linguistic competence is through explicit prompting (e.g., "Which sentence is more acceptable?"). Prior work indicates that such prompting underperforms compared to standard token-probability-based methods in smaller models, but improves in larger models. We test this in a new domain: semantic focus-sensitivity, responsible for contrasts like "Lucy only SWAM yesterday" vs. "Lucy only swam YESTERDAY". Testing models of various sizes using text-based focus markers like boldface and italics, we find universal above-chance performance for token probabilities. Prompting results mostly align with previous findings, but in some larger models they outperform probabilities by a wide margin. We propose that this is because LMs are not prone to produce out-of-the-blue focus marking, which muddies results from token probabilities in a way that does not affect

translated_title: 语言模型语言学评估中的提示与概率：来自语义焦点敏感性的证据
translated_abstract: 随着语言模型的不断改进，通过显式提示（例如，“哪个句子更可接受？”）来评估其语言能力已成为越来越常见的方法。先前的研究表明，在较小的模型中，这种提示方法的表现不如基于标准标记概率的方法，但在较大的模型中表现有所改善。我们在一个新的领域中对此进行了测试：语义焦点敏感性，它负责诸如"Lucy only SWAM yesterday"与"Lucy only swam YESTERDAY"之间的对比差异。通过使用粗体和斜体等基于文本的焦点标记来测试各种规模的模型，我们发现基于标记概率的方法普遍表现出高于随机水平的性能。提示方法的结果大多与先前的研究发现一致，但在一些较大的模型中，其表现大幅超过了概率方法。我们提出，这是因为语言模型不太倾向于主动产生无上下文背景的焦点标记，这使得标记概率方法的结果变得模糊，而这种影响并不……
tldr: 该研究首次在语义焦点敏感性这一新领域评估语言模型，发现基于标记概率的方法在所有模型中均高于随机水平，而提示方法在部分较大模型中大幅优于概率方法，其原因是语言模型不倾向于主动产生焦点标记。
en_tdlr: Testing language models on semantic focus-sensitivity shows that token probabilities universally perform above chance, while prompting outperforms probabilities by a wide margin in some larger models, likely because LMs rarely produce out-of-the-blue focus marking.
